suggestions.title: Retire the v1 export endpoint
suggestions.brief:
`GET /api/v1/export` has had no caller in the access log for 60 days (checked `logs/access-2026-08.log` and `-09.log`). Removing it drops 1,100 lines and a dependency on `csv-stringify` with two open advisories.

Done when:
- the route and its tests are gone
- `npm audit` no longer lists `csv-stringify`
suggestions.verdict: Removing a public endpoint is a promise to users that only the owner can break; the evidence is solid, the call is yours.

suggestions.title: Cache the product feed for a minute
suggestions.brief: Every home page load refetches the full feed (`src/feed.ts:41`); the trace in `TASK-002` shows 400 ms of the 650 ms page time there. A one-minute cache keyed by locale would cut it to one fetch a minute.

suggestions.title: Add a smoke test for the checkout page
suggestions.brief: The checkout page has unit tests but no end-to-end check; `TASK-002` would have been caught a week earlier with one.

suggestions.title: Write the release notes by hand each release
suggestions.brief: The generated notes read like a commit log.
suggestions.verdict: The release job already renders the notes from the merged task titles (TASK-001 landed that); fix the titles, not the notes.
